name: Danger Trail
detailed_description:
Danger Trail is an online multiplayer game for 4-16 players. Beat up your friends using a bunch of absurd traps or try to escape from the clutches of your worst friend.
Compete and have fun destroying friendships.

ONLINE MULTIPLAYER

Play however you want. With Danger Trail, between 4 and 16 players can compete online, and the fun that ruins friendships is guaranteed.

ASSORTMENT OF TRAPS

This is war! Use a whole collection of traps available on each map to try to prevent your friends from reaching the end of the course. From the simple "spike" to the outrageous "bone-crushing axe," Danger Trail traps will make you laugh and rage in equal parts. It has never been so easy and satisfying to crush your friends' dreams of victory!

CUSTOMIZATION

Want to show off your latest outfits to your friends? Want to strike terror into your enemies? With the assortment of customizable skins, you can choose your favorite one to shine on the battlefield and make sure everyone recognizes you.

THEMES

Fight, run, or catch in an endless variety of different themes, from endless dungeons to the wild west. Each theme has its own set of traps, atmosphere, music, and skins for players.

PROCEDURAL MAPS

Each game will be unique as the map is procedurally generated, so even if you play the same theme, you will encounter different traps and new courses; the fun is guaranteed.

GLOBAL SCORING

Earn points in each match, whether by eliminating your friends or escaping from their clutches, to climb up the leaderboard.
At the end of the match, you'll be able to see your overall scores along with those of all the Dangers.
